rapport_notes: Warm, patient, personable tone throughout; good active listening with frequent acknowledgment ('Mm-hmm,' 'Okay, thank you'); handled customer's detailed inventory walk-through with genuine engagement.
process_discipline_notes: Asked 'does that feel fair' equivalent twice without silence (once at 'before the breakdown' / 'Does that feel fair question' and again after differentiators); no silence held after agenda question.

evidence_quotes.quid_pro_quo: This will probably take five to ten minutes, the entire call... let me ask you some questions to get us on the right track and then once we're done with the details, I'll update the estimate accordingly to what you need us to handle.
evidence_quotes.their_agenda: Before we start with the pricing and the estimate, I would like to know Denise if you have any specific concerns what are you most worried about for this upcoming room? I wanna make sure we address everything.
evidence_quotes.two_layers_deep: Customer raised concern about wrapping and bed fit; Amy acknowledged with 'Okay, so very good question. Well, the Wapping the furniture even if it's only going to a garage or storage unit, we'll definitely take care of that.' No second-layer dig into the concern; immediate pivot to solution/pricing.
evidence_quotes.sheet1_careful_with: We have a no worries damage coverage wherein we allocate up to $2,000 per move. To either repair, replace or reimburse any damages cost by our team.
evidence_quotes.on_time_guarantee: We also have our on time guarantee for any reason that our movers cannot make it to the timeline that we promise... we will give you a discount by the end of the day or for your total bill.
evidence_quotes.beats_it_pay_less: If we go on twenty half hours, we will prorate the time in every fifteen minute increments. In that way, you only pay for the actual time fees.
evidence_quotes.estimate_anchor: Typically for an 1800 square foot move we would send three movers for six to eight hours... I would suggest that your budget for six, maybe up to seven hours just in case needed... If it only takes six hours, that's $1,308 and then seven hours is $1,526, that's for Saturday.

top_strength: Exceptional patience and completeness in inventory discovery; Amy methodically worked through the customer's entire multi-room list without rushing, asked clarifying questions about parking and elevator access, and personalized the estimate anchors to the specific two-stop, downsizing scenario.
coaching_note: This is a properly routed walkthrough-scheduler call (1800 sq ft with complex multi-stop logistics), but you missed the explicit agenda follow-up: when Denese raised the canopy-bed fit concern, you answered it directly but never asked 'tell me more about that' or 'what else is on your worry list'—a single acknowledgment and then straight to solution. On future complex moves, probe deeper into stated concerns before pivoting to pricing, even when the call is routed to walkthrough.
